cohort: prospective public-map expansion after the original six-map inventory; MapZoo Berlin is distinct from installed gym Berlin
publisher_license: MIT as declared by repository LICENSE at pinned commit; copyright 2026 Zhouheng Li
source_format: 11 semicolon columns with named header; select s,x,y,psi,kappa,vx,ax by name, then arc-length resample
native_format: three header rows, 7 semicolon columns s,x,y,psi,kappa,vx,ax, explicit duplicate closure
track_status: source geometry passes; source speed fails registered limits; derived target speed passes
finish: Gym checkpoint_done retained; first geometric crossing separately interpolated after departure and half-line progress

tuning.selection: completion without collision, then minimum independent RMS reference distance; every candidate retained
tuning.freeze: commit chosen parameters and line hashes before evaluation

timing: wall clock per control call is reported; ideal simulated-time actuation, no compute delay injected in nominal results; 10 ms control deadline
noncompletion: null comparison lap time, retain terminal reason and telemetry; no finite collision penalty
scope: public simulation development only; no Kresse archive, reserved group, physical car or historical simulator-identity claim
